_README: CANONICAL SOURCE OF PORTFOLIO FACTS. Edit here and nowhere else.
src/lib/agent-knowledge.ts     -> imports this file directly, renders the LLM prompt
Why this lives under backend/ and not at the repo root:
docker-compose.yml sets the backend build context to ./backend, and Render's
root directory is 'backend'. A root-level knowledge/ would not exist inside the
backend image. The frontend builds from the repo root (no .vercelignore), so it
can reach down into backend/. This directory is the intersection of all three
build contexts. Moving it up breaks production silently.
Rule: every claim here must be demonstrable. See CLAUDE.md section 0.

projects.name: AI TradeFlow
